scene_mappings.heading: EXT. TIDAL CAUSEWAY - DUSK
scene_mappings.objective: Rowan must pass the causeway before the tide covers it.
scene_mappings.conflict: The keeper delays her while concealing that the gate is still open.
scene_mappings.turn: Rowan gives up her tide map and crosses without permission.

scene_mappings.heading: INT. SIGNAL HOUSE - NIGHT
scene_mappings.objective: Rowan must warn the fishing boats without a working lamp.
scene_mappings.conflict: Rising water and failed equipment remove the expected signal method.
scene_mappings.turn: She converts the survey pole into an audible warning.

setup_payoffs.relationship: The survey pole carried across the causeway becomes the replacement warning signal.
